faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Things you might be wondering about corporate email infrastructure.

delivery.question: How long does the setup and migration process take?
delivery.answer: A basic setup from scratch is usually completed within 1-2 days. However, if heavy data (gigabytes of emails) needs to be migrated from an old server, this background process can take 5-7 days.

pricing.question: Should I choose Google Workspace or Microsoft 365?
pricing.answer: It depends on your team's working habits. If you heavily use Office programs like Excel/Word, Microsoft 365 is suitable; if you seek collaboration, simplicity, and cloud storage, Google Workspace is better. We decide together after an analysis.

revisions.question: Can we open as many email accounts as we want?
revisions.answer: Technically yes, but services like Google and Microsoft charge a monthly license fee 'per user'. To optimize costs, we set up shared addresses (info@, accounting@) as free routing aliases.

maintenance.question: Will my old emails, folders, or calendar be lost?
maintenance.answer: Absolutely not. With our specialized migration tools, we copy all your emails, folder structures you've created, contacts, and calendar events exactly into the new system.

migration.question: I don't have a company domain yet, can you help?
migration.answer: Yes. We offer the process of finding the most suitable domain name for your corporate identity, purchasing it, registering it, and then setting up the email infrastructure as a single end-to-end package.

mobile.question: Will I be able to manage my emails from my phone (mobile)?
mobile.answer: Of course. The systems we set up are 100% compatible with iOS and Android. You can use them with instant synchronization via the official Gmail/Outlook apps or your phone's native mail app.
